mechanism_narrative: FGFR1 (RTK, Tyr kinase) and TGFBR2 (Ser/Thr kinase) are forced into proximity by the flexible_GS4 linker (~20 Å). FGFR1's Tyr kinase transphosphorylates TGFBR2's juxtamembrane Tyr residues, creating docking sites for SH2-domain adaptors GRB2/SHC1/FRS2/GAB1/PIK3R1 that activate MAPK-ERK and PI3K-AKT signaling — pathways normally absent from TGFBR2 signaling. The canonical TGFBR2→TGFBR1→SMAD2/3 cascade is disrupted because TGFBR1 is sterically excluded from the co-cluster (large ECD asymmetry: FGFR1 ECD ~355 aa vs TGFBR2 ECD ~143 aa, ratio >2×). PLCG1 is also excluded due to the tight geometry. The net biased output is a pro-youthful MAPK/AKT signal that upregulates muscle structural genes (ACTA2, MYL9, MYH11) while suppressing aged IEGs (EGR1, FOS, JUN, IL32).
